messages:
maria: FYI I kicked off a small targeted telemetry reprocess for tenant 'acme' to fill missing agg_hours from 2026-03-15T00:00 to 2026-03-15T04:00. route=cost-optimized, canary=1%. Leaving this thread in case console/quota folks want to pause or audit.

sam: Can you paste the exact command + flags you used?

maria: run-replayer --tenant acme --window '2026-03-15T00:00/2026-03-15T04:00' --preserve-ids --route cost-optimized --canary 1 --dryrun=false --concurrency 8

lee: Heads-up: route=cost-optimized hits preemptible capacity. Might trigger fallback to dedicated-variant and cause short SLO blips. Any mitigations?

maria: We set per-request timeout to 3s and an automatic fallback to dedicated-variant when slot allocation fails. Also reduced concurrency to 8 to smooth load.

jen: How are we handling dedupe this time? Last replay caused duplicate agg increments when events arrived out-of-order.

maria: Replayer uses idempotent upserts keyed by event_id+source_signature. Also applying a 7d dedupe window to reject late duplicates.

sam: Please tag this run so Console filters it as a targeted reslice (so it doesn't look like a full backfill).

maria: @console-bot tag add thread 1712345678 targeted-reslice acme

console-bot: tag added: targeted-reslice,acme

lee: Quota note: dry-run gave ~30k compute-min estimate but ramping factors + retries push us toward ~120k compute-min. Our monthly reprocess pool is 200k. Want to confirm you're OK with that burn.

maria: Aware. I set a soft cap on concurrency and will pause if we exceed 150k used. We can also switch to rate-limited mode.

jen: Let's formalize a canary milestone: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. At each step run the aggregate-delta check.

maria: Agreed. Canary plan in PR: 1% for 30m, check delta < 0.2% vs baseline; if pass, 10% for 1h; if pass, full run.

sam: We need that delta surfaced in Console as a tile and an alert if >0.5% sustained 15m. Ops should be able to abort from the UI.

lee: I'll add a temporary dashboard query: sum(recompute_delta)/sum(baseline) by hour for tenant=acme. Create an alert rule on >0.5% for 15m.

jen: Partial failures: if one hour chunk fails repeatedly, do we retry indefinitely or move it to dead-letter for manual review?

maria: Retry policy is 3 attempts with exponential backoff. After 3 failures we move the chunk into dead-letter and surface an operator action link in console for manual replay with adjusted parameters.

sam: Make sure dead-letter exposes raw payload + original event timestamps and the trace id for correlation.

maria: Will include run_id and trace id in the dead-letter metadata.

lee: Ops request: automatically throttle this run down to best-effort if infra pressure on EU-gpu-pool exceeds 85%.

maria: Added route override: if infra_pressure > 0.85 then route -> best-effort and lower concurrency to 2.

jen: Cost estimator on Console currently assumed fp32. Since cost-optimized route will use int8 quant/profile, estimator should factor quant profile, token packing, and batch multipliers.

sam: Yup — estimator needs model_quant_profile param. Otherwise we underreport cost by ~20%.

maria: I'll open a tiny PR to pass quant_profile=auto to estimator API and update the run UI.

console-bot: note: run 1712345678 started (canary 1%) — link: https://console.internal/runs/1712345678

sam: :thumbsup: keep us posted

maria: Canary completed, delta 0.08% (within threshold). Moving to 10% now.

lee: Watching infra metrics and quota dashboards.

jen: At 10% we hit a transient retry cluster (~02:17) but it recovered after backoff. No data drift observed.

maria: Proceeding to full run. I'll set the console tag to 'in-progress' and mark this thread resolved after run completes. Tagging @oncall for visibility.

oncall: Acknowledged — will watch SLOs and escalate if we see regressions.

maria: Thanks everyone — will post final cost/coverage numbers when it finishes.
